description: The pure-AST `argmin` / `argmax` templates of lib/relational.esm under every compiler: argmin_template.esm applies them to every scenario of scenarios.json (ties, signed zeros, infinities, NaN candidates; each candidate `num[k] / den[k]` over two `const` arrays so 0/0 and ±1/0 can be written) and asserts the 1-based index at tolerance 0; nearest_generator_template_ode.esm is the value_invention_geometry nearest-generator document with its arg-witness written as the `argmin` template, and must integrate to the same values as that document. The two rewrites of the value_invention_geometry key documents (rewrites/edge_enumeration_ode.esm, rewrites/bin_skolem_count_ode.esm) run here too and integrate to those documents' values.

scope_excluded.go: No simulator and no inline-test runner, so a tier that DRIVES one cannot be run here (API_SPEC.md §3, capability profiles). Go checks the expansion of the templates in pkg/esm/relational_templates_test.go. This is an exclusion from the CATEGORY, not from the rule.
scope_excluded.typescript: No simulator and no inline-test runner, so a tier that DRIVES one cannot be run here (API_SPEC.md §3, capability profiles). TypeScript checks the expansion of the templates in src/relational-templates.test.ts. This is an exclusion from the CATEGORY, not from the rule.

tolerances.detail: The argmin_template.esm assertions are indices read at t = 0 and must match exactly (the document's tolerance is zero, and every binding must reproduce the golden bit for bit). The nearest-generator document integrates a constant rate over one unit of time, so its values carry the integrator's rounding; the band is the value_invention_geometry tier's.

fixtures.note: Generated from scenarios.json: one unknown per scenario.
tests/conformance/value_invention_geometry/fixtures/nearest_generator_ode.esm with its arg-witness written as the `argmin` template; its golden equals that document's.
value_invention_geometry/fixtures/edge_enumeration_ode.esm with its edge key written as edge_key(a, b, 1, 4); its golden matches that document's.

value_invention_geometry/fixtures/bin_skolem_count_ode.esm with its bin keys split into per-component join columns and its pair key written as pair_key(i, j, 1, 1, 4, 4); its golden matches that document's.
